files.$comment: On-demand reference; it does not enter the context file. core-guidelines refers to it by relative name. overwrite is used because the complete file belongs to this package.
Generic brand template. Like the playbook, it is loaded on demand because visual guidance matters only for front-end work, documents, or diagrams.

preflight.message: AGENTS.override.md takes precedence over AGENTS.md, so the security guidance will be silently ignored. Move its content into AGENTS.md or remove the override.

Current Windows Codex ignores managed_config.toml. AgentShield no longer writes or removes this developer-profile file. If its first line is the AgentShield security-team-block header, rename it to a backup after review.

notes: Repository AGENTS.md takes precedence over the global file when they conflict. Global guidance is a default, not a ceiling; the pipeline remains the real gate.
